sources.title: Qwen3.8-9B Distill by Empero: Benchmarks and Local Setup
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-9B Distill is a full-parameter fine-tune released by Empero that transfers reasoning behavior from a much larger teacher model, Qwen3.8 2.4T A95B, into the smaller Qwen3.5-9B architecture. It was trained on roughly 70,000 curated chain-of-thought traces covering math, code, general reasoning, instruction following, and tool use.
